retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast urban music layout featuring large blocky display type, vinyl record motifs, and a dark background with red and silver accents.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, symmetrical composition anchored by a central vinyl record graphic split into two halves, framing bold, sans-serif display text. The top features heavy, stylized block lettering with a red-to-black gradient and blue outlines, while the bottom uses clean, high-contrast silver typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical framing of central text by vinyl record segments
Hierarchical contrast between heavy top display type and clean bottom metadata
Color-coded information layers using red for secondary details and silver for primary titles
Dark background providing high contrast for metallic and vibrant text effects
coreInvariants: Split vinyl record graphic framing the central title
Heavy block-style display type with thick outlines at the top

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary title is centered and large; secondary branding is at the top; metadata is at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central 'Urban Chart Smashers' text framed by the silver vinyl arcs.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow starting from the heavy header, moving to the central title, and ending at the bottom credits.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant black negative space in the lower half to balance the dense top and center.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black background for depth and contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Silver/Grey for primary text and record graphics.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for secondary metadata and header gradients.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between silver text and black background; low saturation red for accents.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy geometric sans-serif and blocky display faces.
letterConstructionRules: Top header uses thick, chamfered corners and heavy outlines.
Central text uses rounded, bold sans-serif with drop shadows.
Bottom text uses clean, wide-set geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' characters in the top header are modified into tall, narrow rectangles with inner cutouts.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy block display for branding paired with clean geometric sans for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight of the top header.
Matches the clean geometric feel of the metadata.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a solid black background with two symmetrical silver-grey vinyl record segments on the left and right, leaving a large circular void in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large silver sans-serif text in the center void. Place a heavy, red-gradient block-letter header at the top with blue outlines. Add small red and silver metadata text at the bottom right.

verificationChecks: Is the central text framed by the record arcs?
Does the top header have a red-to-black gradient?
Are all primary text elements in uppercase?

postGenerationChecks: Check for symmetrical alignment of the record arcs.
Ensure the red gradient in the header is visible.
Verify that the central title is the largest text element.
Confirm the background is pure black or very dark charcoal.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban music layout = (Symmetrical Vinyl Arcs + Heavy Block Header) / Black Background * (Silver + Red Accent Palette)
